images.alt: Photo of the Director-General of Health Audrey Sonerson, seated at a desk signing documents in an office setting. Behind the person is a teal display panel showing Minostry of Health values such as Manaakitanga, Whakaponō, and Kaitiakitanga, alongside a blue Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora banner. The lower part of the image includes the New Zealand Government and Ministry of Health logos.

Photo of Wei Lin Lai Permanent Secretary (Policy & Development) seated at a desk holding up a large red document folder. Behind the person is a backdrop patterned with multiple Ministry of Health Singapore logos. A Singapore flag stands to the left of the person. At the bottom of the image are the New Zealand Government and Ministry of Health logos.

Group photo of multiple people standing together in a hallway with dark flooring. Two large, framed artworks with bold, colourful designs hang on the wall behind the group. The lighting is bright from overhead ceiling panels. At the bottom of the graphic are the New Zealand Government and Ministry of Health logos.

post.text: New Zealand and Singapore have signed a Health Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), marking an important step in strengthening the bilateral health relationship between both countries. Huge thanks to the Global Health Team and everyone who contributed to this work — kōkiri ngātahi in action.
